API: Session(profile,configuration_profile).begin(meta).feed(bytes)...end(); single active object; one persistent guard+decoder pair per selected profile/config
input_layer: Literal bytes of the stored Native member object, exactly the layer hashed by Root object SHA. NOT outer transport/archive/framing bytes. For a literal *.traceg.xz member feed its original xz bytes.

canonical_compression_values.xz: stored xz member bytes, incrementally decompressed
canonical_compression_values.gzip: stored gzip member bytes, incrementally decompressed; normalization only, not a claim native PipeReader directly supports gzip filenames
canonical_compression_values.aux: opaque literal hash only, no decompression/record qualification

outer_archives: Root existing restore/archive layer handles tar.zst/tar.gz and yields exact member bytes. Do not feed whole archive bytes as an individual trace. Adapter performs no member-path body open.
begin_meta: size and sha256 of literal stored member
optional frozen relative_path checked against advisory kind classifier
framing: uint32BE length of(tag+payload),B JSON<=64KiB,D literal bytes<=64MiB,E empty final EOF,Q empty quit; no interleaved objects.
state_across_windows: Keep same ObjectStream/decompressor/partial-line/TB/warp/native-header context across arbitrary64MiB windows. Native subprocesses persist across objects. No suffix acceptance after process/checkpoint state loss.
header_context: Decoded headers validate SM70,grid/block/nregs/shmem and default legacy version0 vs explicitversion3. At header delimiter attach real kernel metadata carrier shmem/local bases; source-reachable onlythese2fields,version/lineinfo passed every batch. Header context SHA and fixedconfig manifest SHA retained. Missingbases native fallback exposed, not invented.
EOF_proof: whole literal size and SHA equal frozen member
xz/gzip decompressor EOF true, CRC errors fail, no unused/trailing or concatenated stream
complete final newline and no partialrecord
complete TB/warp and declaredinst counts/full grid envelope with lastEXIT
every parsedrecord gets actual native decoder row,exactBATCH_OK count and totalnative count equality
only then emit end receipt; errors retain incomplete active object and no success

hash_domains.literal_native_bytes_sha256: exact stored raw bytes; same layer as Root Native object hash
hash_domains.decoded_text_sha256: derived decompressed/plain textual bytes, not a second physical Native read
hash_domains.decoded_metadata_sha256: canonical JSON rows from actual native decoder; derived metadata, not literal byte-integrity proof

resource_bounds.XZ_dictionary_memory: No internal lzma memlimit in preserved envelope; Root parent process RAM bound remains required. Output-piece/total limits do not claim a separate hard dictionary cap.

commandlist_aux_semantics.cmdlist: strict envelope/ordered refs only; no decodedinstruction PASS; Root mustjoin exact frozen member inventory/graph
commandlist_aux_semantics.aux: literal size/SHA only, actual_native_decoder_records0, decoded_text_sha256null, no ISA qualification
commandlist_aux_semantics.tracez: explicitunsupported, not silently treated as trace text

actual_validation: 179 synthetic cases including actual64MiB boundary,all5configs,plain/xz/gzip andframed2objects. No new real body/header reads.
